story-context.acceptanceCriteria: See story file ACs 1–10. The field-level schema is normative and lives in Dev Notes.

dependencies.python: pydantic>=2.7 (already installed), pyyaml>=6.0 (already installed). No new dependencies.

story-context.constraints: - Pydantic v2 API only (ConfigDict, model_validator, Field, Annotated discriminated union). No pydantic.v1 shims. - All models extra="forbid" and frozen=True. - Models are data only: no methods except content_hash() on ScenarioConfig and validators. - No mechanism defaults beyond those listed; if a value is unclear, make it required rather than guessing a default. - Python 3.12-compatible syntax (CI target), even though Seoul runs 3.14. - Do not create kernel/engine, protocol, or agent code. Config only.

interfaces.interface: load_scenario(path: Path) -> ScenarioConfig ; raises pydantic.ValidationError on invalid input, FileNotFoundError on missing path
content_hash(self) -> str ; 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, compact separators, mode="json")
exit 0 valid; 2 missing file; 3 validation error (message on stderr)

tests.standards: pytest in tests/, one test per AC-9 bullet, descriptive names (test_unknown_agent_type_rejected). Use tmp_path to write invalid YAML variants rather than committing many fixture files. Assert on pydantic.ValidationError and, where cheap, on the offending field name in str(exc).
